name: foundry-agent-gateway
description: Local MCP gateway that lets AI agents work inside a Foundry VTT world.

foundry_url.title: Foundry URL
foundry_url.description: The exact origin you open Foundry at: scheme, host and port only, no path and no trailing slash, e.g. https://foundry.local or http://localhost:30000. Only this origin may pair with the gateway (--allow-origin).

link_port.title: Module link port
link_port.description: Local port the Foundry module connects to (AGENT_GATEWAY_LINK_PORT).

role.title: Role
role.description: Accepted values: 'player' or 'gm' (AGENT_GATEWAY_ROLE). 'gm' exposes GM-only tools; leave as 'player' unless you need them.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: One of debug, info, warn, error (AGENT_GATEWAY_LOG_LEVEL).
